task1_transportIntegration.architecture: DECLARED TRANSPORT -> selector -> implemented adapter -> runtime selected transport -> receipt-bound transport identity
task1_transportIntegration.defectRemoved: context-ledger-v1.mjs chose its adapter with a ternary defaulting to SshRsyncTransport, an unimplemented stub whose every method throws.
task1_transportIntegration.separationEnforced: A transport never names its own destination. objectRoot, host and share come from the storage authority contract passed in.
task1_transportIntegration.noFallback: Unknown, unimplemented, misconfigured or authority-less selection REFUSES. The not-implemented check runs before configuration and authority so nothing downstream can rescue a stub into an apparent success.
task1_transportIntegration.authorityGate: selectTransport refuses unless storageAuthority.state === PROVEN. Because live authority is CONFLICTED, the production path refuses by construction rather than by intention.
task1_transportIntegration.credentialsHandling: requiredEnv lists VARIABLE NAMES ONLY. No value is read, compared, logged, hashed or placed in a receipt.

task2_structuralValidator.correction: The physical blob is [12-byte nonce][16-byte tag][ciphertext] and contains NO key-version field. The module states this in its output rather than implying recoverability.
task2_structuralValidator.hashAgreementSemantics: null when not asserted - never conflated with 'passed'

task3_destinationExecution.guard: TRANSPORT_READBACK is registered ONLY so it can be refused. assertIndependentOfTransport throws MECHANISM_READS_BACK_THROUGH_TRANSPORT.
task3_destinationExecution.whyReadbackIsRefused: Write-then-download-then-hash-locally proves the transport is self-consistent, which a symmetric read/write fault also satisfies.

failClosed.SSH_REMOTE_SHA256SUM: ALLOWLIST_EXPANSION_REQUIRED - restricted policy allowlists rsync only; NOT broadened here
failClosed.DSM_API_REMOTE_HASH: DESTINATION_EXECUTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED - authenticating to production DSM is not authorized for this mission

task3_destinationExecution.genericWrtAuthority: Takes whatever authority it is given and refuses while that authority is not PROVEN.

task4_protectedSet.keyVersionModel: CIPHERTEXT OBJECT + LEDGER ENTRY -> keyVersion -> IT Vault custody pointer. Never envelope -> keyVersion.
task4_protectedSet.accountingRefusal: assertManifestAccounting refuses counts that disagree with the adjudication, and refuses any manifest that folds provisional objects into production.
task4_protectedSet.noSecretsEmitted: Custody is a POINTER. No key material, tokens or passphrases enter any artifact.

replicationPerformed.note: Manifests and interfaces only, as authorized.
